claims.verbatim:
Bark Grossherzogin Anna (Meck), Wendt, Trieste, 54[?] days,
with mdse to Funch, Meincke & Wendt. In lat 24 20, lon
49 15, spoke whaling bark Triton, from St Catharines, bound
N, with 570 bbls sp.
